items.question: Under what condition must the hundred-thousand mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass be offered by one who has acted, addressed to the god-worshipped one?
premises: A mark of a hundred thousand rests in the mass of syllables at the forehead.
The action has already been completed by the practitioner.
This offering is directed to that which is worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The completed act qualifies a specific forehead mark of a hundred thousand for offering to the god-worshipped recipient.
uncertainties: The exact ritual recipient remains context-dependent from surrounding verses.
items.plain_english: One who has acted should offer the hundred-thousand mark situated in the mass of forehead syllables to the god-worshipped one.
